reviews.title: Does Not Work
reviews.text: At first the game was fun, but I never got any experience or advanced.  I found items that essentially did nothing to change the game play, and all the monsters were the same troglodytes.  I submitted a ticket and was told basically, yeah all those things are in development.  You can only get XP for killing NPCs.  The AI has memory issues…according to them…that make it so nothing really works. I paid for this subscription, and now I want a refund.  They responded with how much they appreciate that I am playing…again…nothing works…they are charging for it…and they know it does not work…They should not be charging if this is a beta.  They full on admit that none of the features work.  It is a great concept, but it should work before you charge people.

reviews.title: Great Concept, Prohibitively Expensive.
reviews.text: The AI works as advertised, and the interface is flawless in my opinion, but without any ways to play without In-App-Purchases, it’s reasonable to consider a subscription. But at $15 a month, you only get 200 rounds…for the month…that’s immensely predatory, and at a dime a pop for any extra rounds, anyone wanting to spend more that 5 minutes a week in your app is going to be paying through the nose for the privilege. My sincere advice? Pick a plan. If it’s a round system give customers a way to earn rounds without exorbitant fees. Ads are great for this. Alternatively, if it’s a subscription, rounds should be either a nonissue, or subscribers are afforded daily rounds. Either system would be a substantial improvement over trying to do both and creating a soulless money pit.

Such a golden opportunity wasted by a cash grab. I’ll be cancelling my subscription and uninstalling the app.

reviews.title: Incorrect information
reviews.text: Was excited to use this, haven’t had a chance to really get into a dnd group where I live, and wanted a taste of it. Literally within 5 minutes of using it, im asked about the backstory and where I come from, I give it the name of my town. Then opening scene i drop down behind someone to “sneak up behind” and the system says i press a blade to his throat. The name it gives my blade? The name of my origin town. Completely broke the scripts and honestly kind of ruined it for me. Like if the name of my origin town was Washington, it literally said “you drop down and press Washington to his throat” like bro cmon. Get me invested before making little mistakes instead of butchering it right away. 0/10, not worth the time to re-try
